meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 它会扫描项目，找出未使用的导入、变量、函数、类型和孤立文件，用代码引用检查逐项确认后，将删除任务分给多个并行代理。每个代理负责一批文件，修改后运行类型检查并各自提交，最后做整体验证并汇报。
howto.when: 当用户提到 “remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词，或直接要求清理项目中的未使用代码时触发。也可以通过附加参数指定只清理某个文件、目录或符号。

say.text: 移除这个项目里的所有死代码
say.note: 开始全项目扫描，确认后并行删除。

say.text: 只清理 src/hooks 目录下的未使用代码
say.note: 将扫描范围限定在该目录。

say.text: 删除未使用的导入和常量，但别动入口文件和测试
say.note: 入口文件和测试受保护，不会删除。

howto.what_en: Scans for unused imports/variables/functions/types/orphaned files, verifies via LSP, delegates removals to parallel agents. Each agent edits, typechecks, and commits separately; then overall verification and summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', etc., or asks to clean up unused code. Supports narrowing scope via arguments like a file path, directory, or symbol name.

say_en.text: Remove all dead code from this project.
say_en.note: Starts full project scan and parallel removal.

say_en.text: Only clean unused code in src/hooks directory.
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory.

say_en.text: Remove unused imports and constants, but leave entry points and tests alone.
say_en.note: Entry points and tests are protected.
